memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Vitamin B12 deficiency
- Status: newly diagnosed, symptomatic with mild fatigue and glossitis.
- Plan: start methylcobalamin 1500 mcg oral daily; check serum B12, MCV, haemoglobin in 1 week.
Migraine
- Status: episodic migraine, 4–5 days/month, currently on propranolol 40 mg OD for prevention, sumatriptan 50 mg SOS, topiramate 25 mg HS, naproxen 500 mg SOS.
- Plan: continue current regimen; monitor headache diary.
Weight 68 kg; waist circumference 84 cm (>80 cm female cut‑off).
Diet advice
- Breakfast: include protein, avoid sugary cereals.
- Lunch: balanced Indian meal with dal, vegetables, limited rice.
- Dinner: light, early, avoid fried snacks.
Due: HbA1c check in 3 months (routine).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Prescription:
- Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD, oral, after food.
- Propranolol 40 mg OD, oral, after food.
- Sumatriptan 50 mg SOS, oral, after food.
- Topiramate 25 mg HS, oral, after food.
- Naproxen 500 mg SOS, oral, after food.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum Vitamin B12: 180 pg/mL (reference 200‑900).
MCV: 98 fL (reference 80‑100).
Haemoglobin: 12.2 g/dL (reference 12.0‑15.5).
Interpretation: borderline low B12, mild macrocytosis, Hb normal.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Vitamin B12 deficiency
- Status: on methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD for 2 months, fatigue improved, glossitis resolved.
- Plan: continue same dose; repeat B12 in 3 months.
Migraine
- Status: headache frequency reduced to 2–3 days/month, mild breakthrough pain.
- Plan: increase propranolol to 60 mg OD; keep SOS meds unchanged.
Weight 67.5 kg; waist circumference 83 cm (>80 cm).
Diet advice
- Breakfast: add boiled egg, avoid sweets.
- Lunch: increase vegetable portion, limit rice to 1 cup.
- Dinner: soup + salad, finish by 7 pm.
Due: HbA1c check in 3 months (routine).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been taking the propranolol 60 mg daily and my migraines are down to about one day a week. The sumatriptan works well when I feel aura. I still get occasional tension‑type headaches after long shifts at the hotel. No side effects noticed.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for 2025-11-02 at 10:30 AM with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04) for routine follow‑up of vitamin B12 and migraine. Patient confirmed via clinic app.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Vitamin B12 deficiency
- Status: on methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD, B12 normal, no symptoms.
- Plan: continue same dose; next B12 check in 6 months.
Migraine
- Status: average 1–2 headache days/month, mild intensity, good control on propranolol 60 mg OD.
- Plan: maintain current prophylaxis; review if frequency rises.
Weight 67 kg; waist circumference 82 cm (>80 cm).
Diet advice
- Breakfast: Greek yogurt + nuts, no added sugar.
- Lunch: mixed vegetable curry with chapati, limit rice.
- Dinner: steamed fish or lentils, finish by 7:30 pm.
Due: HbA1c check in 3 months (routine).

memories.text: Neurological examination: normal mental status, cranial nerves II‑XII intact, no focal weakness, normal coordination, gait steady. No signs of chronic migraine complications. Impression: unremarkable neurological exam.
